t: What happens if you say it half asleep
a: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ. ثُمَّ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي. أَوْ دَعَا اسْتُجِيبَ
p: Al-ḥamdu lillāh, wa subḥāna-Llāh, wa lā ilāha illā-Llāh, wa-Llāhu akbar, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā bi-Llāh. Thumma qāla: Allāhumma-ghfir lī. Aw daʿā, ustujīb
m: Praise be to Allah, glory to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is greatest, and there is no power or strength except with Allah. Then he says: O Allah, forgive me. Or he supplicates, and he is answered.
